title: Commissioning Engineer III
location_raw: Ashburn, VA; Manassas, VA
description:
The Commissioning Engineer III is responsible for but not limited to Level 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 commissioning of base building systems, security systems, life safety systems, Electrical, Mechanical, and EPMS/BMS systems of a Data Center environment. This role will oversee, document, and track various aspects of commissioning activities. Activities will include but are not limited to testing and/or validation of connectivity, network infrastructure, security, life safety, other building subsystems and finishes, transformers, electrical switchgear, UPS (Uninterrupted Power Supply), STS (Static Transfer Switch), PDU (Power Distribution Unit), electrical distribution equipment, Chillers, water loops/components, Cooling distribution equipment, Electrical Power Monitoring Systems, and Building Management and automation systems. This role will also serve as a project manager and liaison to a third-party commissioning agent. This role requires work hours to support construction/commissioning activities of data center environments, which may include nights and/or weekends.
This role will be a platform role that may require an estimated 75% travel to other sites around the U.S.

RESPONSIBILITIES, other duties may be assigned.

- Assist in all site construction activity and installations, in coordination with QTS Development Team, external construction resources, to ensure system design, installation and testing adhere to operational standards.

- Develop comprehensive commissioning plans for Level 1, Level 2, Level 3, Level 4, and Level 5 systems, including connectivity, network infrastructure, security, life safety, other building subsystems and finishes, Electrical, Mechanical, and Building Automation components.

- Conduct thorough commissioning activities, ensuring that all systems are installed, tested, and validated according to industry standards and client specifications.

- Identify, track, and resolve any issues during the commissioning process, working closely with the project team to resolve technical challenges.  Utilize findings and provide feedback to program management team to drive continuous improvement.

- Create and/or review detailed commissioning documentation, including test procedures, reports, and as-built documentation, ensuring accuracy and completeness.

- Witness testing of all equipment during commissioning and validate sequence of operations and receipt of all operational documentation.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including design engineers, project managers, contractors, commissioning agents, and facilities operations to ensure seamless integration of systems during the commissioning phase without impact to operational portions of the campus or building.

- Implement quality control measures to ensure the highest standards are met during the build and commissioning process, adhering to regulatory requirements and industry best practices.

- Develop and test site specific standard operating procedures (SOP), method of procedures (MOP), and emergency response procedures (ERP) in coordination with facilities operations.

- Provide training to end-users and maintenance personnel on the operation and maintenance of commissioned systems.

- Uses the Change Management Process to get approval for preventative and corrective maintenance.  Commences & completes the maintenance along with the necessary documentation using the QTS process and software.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Project Management, Computer Science, or a related field or equivalent professional experience

- Seven or more years of work experience in data center engineering, commissioning, project management, or equivalent.

- Background in areas of building maintenance, CCTV and Access control systems, network, telecommunications, and/or fire detection/suppression systems.

- Ability to travel to other Data Center locations as required.

- Proficiency with MS Office Suite.

- US Citizenship for this position is required by law due to federal customer contracts

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Firm understanding of both mechanical and electrical equipment, systems and design related to data centers.

- Knowledge of electricity and medium to low voltage electrical distribution systems

- Experience with emergency backup systems (generators, UPS, battery backup)

- Experience with various mechanical cooling solutions (Chillers, CRAH, CRAC, Pumps, Heat Exchangers, etc.)

- Knowledge of equipment operation and maintenance, single line drawings, critical scripted work, and sequence of operations.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

- Ability to analyze operations of various systems, determine the cause of problems and malfunctions and take corrective action as required.

- The ability to acquire and apply job-related knowledge within set guidelines and expectations.

- Ability to develop solutions and create technical plans on projects
- Strong written, verbal and interpersonal skills.

- Ability to function in a team environment.

- Computer skills and familiarity with MS Office, Outlook, and web-based computer applications.
- Position may involve frequent typing, standing, walking, pushing, pulling, bending, reaching, and lifting.  Lifting requirements up to 50 lbs. regularly, with heavier weight performed with other individuals or lifting aids.

TOTAL REWARDS

- This role is also eligible for a competitive beneﬁts package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; ﬂexible spending and HSA accounts; paid holidays; paid time off; paid volunteer days; employee assistance program; tuition assistance; parental leave; military leave assistance; QTS scholarship for dependents; wellness program, and other company beneﬁts.

- This position is bonus eligible.

title: Solution Architect - (Oracle Fusion ERP & SCM)
location_raw: Suwanee, GA; Ashburn, VA; Irving, TX
description:
We are seeking a strategic senior-level Solution Architect with expertise across Oracle ERP/SCM Cloud and Workday to define and govern our global digital transformation roadmap. This role is accountable for establishing a cohesive enterprise solution architecture that integrates Oracle and Workday platforms, ensures compliance, and drives innovation.  The architect will engage with executive leadership, business units, and IT stakeholders to deliver a future-proof, integrated ERP ecosystem.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Solution Architecture

- Define and maintain the enterprise-wide ERP and SCM solution blueprint, integrating Oracle SCM/ERP.

- Establish a multi-year transformation roadmap that leverages Oracle Financials and SCM for supply chain processes.

- Ensure solution design supports global process harmonization, scalability, and compliance.

- Serve as a trusted advisor to executives on ERP strategy, technology adoption, and transformation governance.

- Evaluate quarterly ERP product releases and emerging technologies (AI/ML, predictive analytics, IoT, blockchain) for enterprise applicability.

Governance & Standards

- Define and enforce governance frameworks for solution design, integrations, data management, and security.

- Drive standardization across ERP platforms to minimize customization.

- Oversee architecture for integrations between Oracle SCM, Workday HCM/Finance, and third-party applications.

- Ensure compliance with global regulatory standards (SOX, GDPR, HIPAA, labor laws).

- Establish KPIs and metrics to track ERP and SCM performance.

Program & Stakeholder Leadership

- Provide strategic oversight across multiple transformation programs (Oracle ERP/SCM transformation and Workday integration & transition).

- Lead executive workshops to align business strategy with system capabilities.

- Act as a decision-making authority on solution design across Oracle and Workday platforms.

- Collaborate with system integrators, vendors, and business leaders to deliver enterprise-wide solutions.

- Manage cross-platform alignment to ensure end-to-end process continuity (e.g., hire-to-retire, source-to-pay, order-to-cash).

Continuous Improvement & Innovation

- Champion digital initiatives such as connected supply chain, AI-driven workforce planning, predictive analytics in finance, and automation .

- Identify opportunities for cross-platform synergies between Oracle and Workday.

- Build long-term vendor partnerships with Oracle and Workday to influence product direction.

- Drive business adoption and change management for ERP and SCM/Finance transformations.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

Strategic & Technical Expertise

- Deep expertise in Oracle ERP Cloud & SCM Cloud (Procurement, Inventory, Order Management, Manufacturing, Planning, Logistics).

- US Citizenship for this position is required by law due to federal customer contracts.

- Knowledge of Workday Finance (Financial Accounting, Procurement, Projects, Expenses) is a plus.

- Proven ability to design integrated enterprise architectures across Oracle, Workday, and third-party applications.

- Broad understanding of integration technologies (Oracle OIC, Workday Studio, REST/SOAP APIs, middleware platforms).

- Knowledge of data governance, security models, and role-based access across both Oracle and Workday.

Leadership & Soft Skills

- Experience shaping enterprise-wide ERP strategy across multiple geographies.

- Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with ability to engage C-level executives.

- Strong governance, negotiation, and decision-making abilities.

- Ability to manage multi-vendor, multi-stream global programs .

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- 15+ years of ERP/HCM/SCM experience in large enterprises.

- 10+ years of combined Oracle ERP/SCM and Workday HCM/Finance experience is a plus.

- 5–7 years in a solution architect or strategic leadership role .

- Experience with at least 2–3 global Oracle SCM/ERP rollouts and 2+ legacy ERP transition / migration .

- Cross-industry exposure (manufacturing, retail, healthcare, logistics, public sector) highly desirable.

TOTAL REWARDS

This role is also eligible for a competitive beneﬁts package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; ﬂexible spending and HSA accounts; paid holidays; paid time off; paid volunteer days; employee assistance program; tuition assistance; parental leave; military leave assistance; QTS scholarship for dependents; wellness program, and other company beneﬁts.

This position is Bonus eligible.

- Create infrastructure/pipelines for new services (SpringBoot, Python, Angular)

- Deploy services on DEV/UAT/PROD environments.

- Manage the installation and configuration of solutions.
